params.markdown:
#### Trellix ePO On-Prem

**Threat Events**

This dashboard gives visibility into Trellix ePO threat events, highlighting total volume, trends over time, threat categories, handling status, detection methods, rules, affected endpoints, actions, severity, network activity, and common threat reasons. Use the Threat Category and Detection Method controls to focus the analysis and support security monitoring, triage, and investigation.
